name: Phantom Armor Tetra Teki ka Mikata ka!? Reikou Rebianna to, Senritsu no Futanari Daikaizou!!
original_name: 霊甲テトラ　敵か味方かッ！？零甲レビアンナと、戦慄のフタナリ大改造ッ！！
source:
Tetra is defeated by a mysterious fighter who suddenly appeared before her. The fighter turns out to be General Lebianna from Glams army.
Her zero armor suits surpass the power of the phantom armor suits. Can Lebianna win over Tetra?

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052375.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
灵甲特特拉被一名突然现身的神秘战士击败。对方原来是格拉姆斯军的将军蕾比安娜。

她所装备的“零甲”，力量甚至凌驾于“灵甲”之上。蕾比安娜最终能否令特特拉归顺自己？
